migrations.rollbackStrategy: Fresh databases can be discarded and recreated. Existing databases must be fingerprinted and marked as baselined; never apply 0000 over them. Production recovery requires a separately approved provider restore or reviewed forward repair.
migrations.environmentStatus: Repository baseline only; no development, staging or production database was inspected or changed.
cautions: Generated from Drizzle schema with partial and expression index predicates manually restored and validator-locked.
Must be compared with each existing environment before that environment is enrolled in ordered migrations.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: The application query is compatible before and after index creation. If index rollout causes an operational problem, roll back the application and remove only these two additive indexes through a separately reviewed forward repair; no user data is transformed.
migrations.environmentStatus: Generated and validated in the repository only; not applied to any database.
cautions: Preflight aborts safely if legacy usernames or emails collide after lowercasing and does not print the identifiers.
Index creation can lock or consume resources on a large users table; apply only in an approved window after measuring the target environment.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: The application is compatible with the nullable columns present. If rollback is required, roll back the Worker first; removing the columns is optional and must be handled as a separately reviewed forward repair after confirming no in-flight phone login or phone-link attempts depend on the stored GudAuth verifier hash material.
migrations.environmentStatus: Generated and validated in the repository only; not applied to any database at commit time.
cautions: Stores only the GudAuth-issued challenge verifier needed for server-to-provider polling; the value must never be returned to browsers, logs, or public APIs.
Apply this additive migration before deploying the Worker code that writes the new column.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Disable SUPPORT_INBOX_ENABLED and roll back the application while retaining support records. No existing user, resource, map or calendar data is transformed. Removing support records requires a separately reviewed retention decision.
migrations.environmentStatus: Local development candidate; production migration is not authorised or applied.
cautions: Contains private user support messages and hashed guest recovery credentials; never expose owner IDs, credential hashes or internal fix evidence to reporting users.
The installed generator omits check constraints; the SQL restores the eight declared support checks and integration tests verify enforcement.
Generator repeated the auth columns already owned by migration 0002 because its snapshot was missing; those duplicate ALTER statements were removed from 0003.
Enable the support API only after this additive migration is applied to the intended environment and its private-access checks pass.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Disable the Guide/support rollout flag and retain optional saved questions. Existing resources, maps, calendars and reports are not transformed. Any removal of stored history requires an explicit user deletion or separately reviewed retention decision.
migrations.environmentStatus: Local development candidate tested on disposable data only; no production migration authorised or applied.
cautions: Guide history is account-owner-only. Support review permissions and guest recovery credentials must never grant history access.
Stores only explicitly reviewed questions and topic references, not old resource payloads or arbitrary generated answers.
The installed generator omits CHECK constraints; all three declared checks are restored in SQL and tested in disposable PostgreSQL.
Apply before enabling private Guide history; no runtime DDL is used.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Disable SUPPORT_INBOX_ENABLED and roll back the application while retaining private notification state. Existing calendar plans and acknowledgements are untouched. Unsave cascades only the corresponding new watch and notification group.
migrations.environmentStatus: Local development candidate tested on disposable PostgreSQL only; production migration and scheduled deployment are not authorised or applied.
cautions: Apply before enabling the notification API or scheduled processing. No runtime DDL is used.
Seven declared CHECK constraints are restored in generated SQL. Persist only fingerprints and typed change codes, never historical resource details.
Category preferences reuse notification_preferences without changing the general Profile switches. New category subscriptions are opt-in.
The new favorite foreign key cascades watch and notice removal on unsave; it does not modify existing calendar or map tables.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Disable SUPPORT_INBOX_ENABLED and roll back the application while retaining private saved searches. Existing resources, favorites, maps, calendar and support data are unchanged. Removing a search is an explicit owner action, not a release rollback.
migrations.environmentStatus: Local development candidate tested only in disposable PostgreSQL; no production migration or deployment authorised or applied.
cautions: Stores explicitly reviewed private search keywords, alert consent, epoch-scoped match hashes and grouped read state; never expose another owner's criteria.
Nine CHECK constraints are restored in SQL because the installed generator omits them. Unique bounded owner slots enforce ten searches per account.
No runtime DDL. Apply before enabling saved-search routes or scheduled processing; the shared rollout flag remains off by default.
Background searches use the same public visibility rules as Guide. Existing master notification consent remains authoritative; edits and resume start a new baseline.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Roll back the application while retaining the additive Region, Region postcode, Region-to-Subregion mapping, and Unmapped postcode data. Existing Subregion routing tables are not transformed. Removing the additive objects or imported layer data requires a separately reviewed forward repair after export and reconciliation.
migrations.environmentStatus: Local development candidate tested on disposable PostgreSQL only; no production migration, data import, push, or deployment authorised or applied.
cautions: Apply this migration before deploying the boundary-layer API or client; the runtime compatibility bootstrap intentionally does not create these governed tables.
Region and Subregion postcode sets overlap by design but live in separate tables. Existing account and resource routing continues to query only subregion_postal_codes.
The Unmapped layer is classification data and never grants access or assigns a user or resource.
Production workbook import is a separate, explicitly confirmed operation and should use the corrected validated source artifact.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Roll back the Worker and client while retaining the singleton settings row. The legacy-compatible open defaults remain authoritative when the feature is absent; no existing user, resource, map, calendar, organization, or share data is transformed.
migrations.environmentStatus: Repository candidate tested locally only; no development, staging, or production database migration, setting change, push, or deployment is authorised or applied.
cautions: Apply this additive migration before enabling the platform-access API or enforcing a non-open mode.
The table is a singleton with optimistic revision checks; only Super Admin may mutate it and every successful mutation must write a sensitive audit event.
The generated migration omitted declared CHECK constraints, so the reviewed SQL restores all five constraints and disposable PostgreSQL tests must verify them.
Open is the compatibility default. Changing production access modes is a separate, explicit operational action after organization onboarding paths and guest share/embed exemptions pass UAT.

migrations.rollbackStrategy: Roll back the Worker and client while retaining additive organization domains, onboarding requests, asset packs, join requests, governed maps, publications, events and notification records. Existing personal My Maps, favorites, resources, calendars and shares are not transformed or referenced by foreign key.
migrations.environmentStatus: Repository candidate tested locally only; no development, staging or production migration, access-mode change, push or deployment is authorised or applied.
cautions: Apply after 0008 and before enabling organization-only registration or Governed Care Map routes. No runtime DDL is used.
Governed Care Maps remain independent from user-owned my_maps; creator ids are audit fields and never provide durable ownership.
Stewardship must be recomputed from current resource staff and organization access on every mutation. Public responses use publication snapshots and opaque tokens.

The installed generator omits CHECK constraints and partial-index predicates; the reviewed SQL restores fourteen checks and five partial or expression index definitions, which disposable PostgreSQL tests verify.
Retirement is reversible for thirty days and archival is a scheduled forward action. It does not delete underlying resources or personal maps.
